description: List supported watchlists (OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU, UK, UN, BIS Entity/Denied Persons/Unverified/Military End User, State ITAR Debarred/Nonproliferation) and GLEIF datasets with current mirrored counts, source URLs, licenses, readiness, and as-of timestamps. Each sanctions list carries lastHarvestedAt, its last successful harvest, and publishedAt, the date its publisher put on that document (not when the list's content last changed); both are absent until this server records a harvest of the list. lastRefresh reports a sanctions refresh that is running or failed and names the lists that failed; sanctionsAsOf is the last refresh in which every list harvested. coverageNotice names unloaded CSL lists and how to refresh them; prior mirror readiness does not establish coverage of newly added lists. For GLEIF, reports Level 2 ownership relationships, reporting-exception coverage, alternate-name index readiness, and whether entity status and successors are loaded. Use this for provenance, freshness, and coverage on any result. Attribution: UK data is under the Open Government Licence v3.0; BIS and State CSL data is supplied by the International Trade Administration under its published terms. This product uses the International Trade Administration’s Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the International Trade Administration.
name: sanctions_list_sources

alternateNamesIndexed.description: Whether the GLEIF alternate-name index — trading, previous, alternative-language, and transliterated names — is built. When false, sanctions_resolve_entity searches legal names only until mirror:init reloads the GLEIF golden copy. True on a GLEIF mirror that has never loaded (leiReady false): its empty index is complete, and the first load builds it with the entities.

coverageNotice.description: Unloaded CSL list codes and refresh guidance. Present when any CSL list has zero mirrored records; prior sanctions readiness does not establish coverage of newly added lists.

entityStatusLoaded.description: Whether a completed mirror:init golden-copy load has written entity status and successors for every GLEIF entity in that copy. A sanctions_get_entity record's own entityStatusLoaded is the per-record answer in either state.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lastRefresh.description: The last sanctions refresh, present only while one is running (in_progress) or after one failed (error); absent before any refresh and once the last one succeeded. While a refresh runs, each list keeps the values of the last run that finished it.

oneOf.description: A sanctions refresh that is running.

startedAt.description: When the running refresh started (UTC ISO 8601).

status.description: A sanctions refresh is running — or was killed before it finished, which reads the same way.

failedSources.description: The lists whose harvest failed in that refresh, in list order; each keeps its previous lastHarvestedAt and publishedAt. Empty when the run recorded its lists' outcomes and none failed: it stopped for another reason (cancelled or out of time). Absent when no list's outcome is recorded for that run — one an earlier server version made, or one that stopped before any list finished — so which lists failed is unknown.

startedAt.description: When the failed refresh started (UTC ISO 8601).

leiAsOf.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed GLEIF sync, when available.

leiReady.description: True once the GLEIF (LEI) mirror has completed at least one full sync.

reportingExceptionsLoaded.description: Whether GLEIF reporting exceptions are loaded. When false, sanctions_trace_ownership reads a parent level with no published relationship as unknown.

sanctionsAsOf.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed sanctions sync — the last refresh in which every list harvested — when available. A list that harvested in a later, partly failed refresh carries a later lastHarvestedAt; neither is a publisher's date.

sanctionsReady.description: True once the sanctions mirror has completed at least one full sync.

sources.description: All supported sources, sanctions lists then the GLEIF dataset. Check coverageNotice for unloaded CSL lists.

items.description: One supported source with current mirrored count, provenance, and license, and for a sanctions list its last harvest and that document's date; zero-record CSL lists are not loaded.

lastHarvestedAt.description: When this list's last successful harvest completed (UTC ISO 8601; sanctions lists only). Absent until this server records a successful harvest of the list — so on a mirror an earlier server version wrote, until its next refresh — which means unknown, not stale. sanctionsAsOf is the mirror-wide value, not this list's.

license.description: Redistribution license / terms for this source.

publishedAt.description: The date the publisher put on the document that harvest read, ISO 8601 at the precision and offset published (a date-only value stays YYYY-MM-DD): OFAC DateOfIssue, EU generationDate, UK DateGenerated, UN dateGenerated, and each CSL list's source_last_updated. It dates the document, not the last change to the list's content: some publishers move it when nothing in the list changed (the UN file is regenerated daily). Absent with lastHarvestedAt, or when the document carried no date this server reads.

recordCount.description: Records currently loaded for this source — for gleif, Level 1 entity records.

relationshipCount.description: GLEIF Level 2 ownership relationships loaded (gleif only).

reportingExceptionCount.description: GLEIF reporting-exception records loaded (gleif only). Absent when the dataset has never been loaded — never read as zero.

url.description: Upstream URL the mirror harvests this source from, as configured — for gleif, the golden-copy API base.

title: sanctions-screening-mcp-server: list sources
